coordination_and_prepare_observed_union.scope: Union by event_id of child prepare, interrupted parent prepare, and parent coordination recorded windows; excludes work outside those boundaries and child final notification. Parent and child windows overlap in wall time; no end-to-end time or joint memory is inferred.

prepare_previous_runs.measurement_method: Token usage from all observed events of the dedicated child session through finish; wall time from child session start to finish; tool process metrics via GNU time and 10ms /proc sampling.
prepare_previous_runs.measurement_scope: User-approved scope: metered prepare commands, excluding a few read-only checks before the meter started. Token figures cover the child session through prepare-stage finish. Model-server memory is excluded; process-tree RSS is sampled.
